entities.summary: Salò Republic, a political institution in Italy during WWII and the Postwar Republic (1940–1945). Grew from Liberation Day — end of German occupation of Italy. Led to the emergence of Allied and Fall of Mussolini; Italy signs armistice with the Allies.
